{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm 'LOYAL' exists
assert 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique(), "'LOYAL' segment not found in data"

# Filter for LOYAL and completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check number of such orders
n_loyal_completed = len(df_loyal_completed)

# Print
print(f"Number of LOYAL, completed orders: {n_loyal_completed}")"}
